message:
No pre-built fuzzer. I need to build it. Let me set up the build environment and build the fuzzer with ASAN. Let me first check what tools are available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'which clang clang++ gcc g++ make autoconf automake libtoolize pkg-config 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; clang --version 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo "---"; ls /usr/lib/llvm*/lib/clang/*/lib/linux/libclang_rt.fuzzer* 2>/dev/null'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
